purpose: Pre-register the complete EAAI benchmark before adding new results.

training_budget.hyperparameter_selection: validation only; one common documented tuning budget per family
training_budget.basis: matches the longest existing PEVA-Gen/MAPPO endpoint schedule and exceeds the 51200-step ablation schedule

evaluation_repetitions.interpretation: episode totals are per learned training seed and per deterministic classical method
evaluation_repetitions.allocation: equal repetitions per scenario; scenario count must divide the requested episode total
evaluation_repetitions.common_random_numbers: identical scenario and environment seed keys across all methods

splits.train: training scenarios only; no test trajectory or forcing support
splits.iid_test: held-out scenarios with no training overlap
splits.stress_test: validation-only unless explicitly marked as an OOD test

fairness_constraints: same observation and action spaces where applicable
same training-step budget and seed list
same sensing, motion, channel, and episode randomization
communication includes payload, header, shared uplink, and shared downlink

analysis.paired_test: exact two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank over seed means
analysis.secondary_test: paired permutation test over seed means
analysis.multiplicity: Holm correction within each endpoint family

amendment_20260920.timing: made before any valid expanded final learned-method run
amendment_20260920.reason: v1 omitted a numeric training budget; the first IPPO seed-0 run was invalidated by a pre-transition bootstrap-observation bug and is excluded
amendment_20260920.code_requirement: post-transition observation regression test must pass before final training

release_gates: all baseline jobs have immutable config and source hashes
all primary and mechanism metrics have source data
all figures and tables regenerate from canonical results
no unsupported deployment or sample-efficiency claim
